package sandboxdriver

import (
	"flag"
	"os"
	"regexp"
	"testing"
	"testing/internal/testdeps"
)

// Run constructs testing's state in the guest. The host's testing.T and M
// contain process resources and are not part of the transferred closure.
func Run(test testing.InternalTest) int {
	if err := os.Setenv("TMPDIR", "/tmp"); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	testdeps.ImportPath = "reflect"
	m := testing.MainStart(testdeps.TestDeps{}, []testing.InternalTest{test}, nil, nil, nil)
	if err := flag.CommandLine.Parse([]string{"-test.v", "-test.run=^" + regexp.QuoteMeta(test.Name) + "$", "-test.timeout=2m"}); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	return m.Run()
}
